connection.dockerLocalhost: Mongo Manager runs in Docker, where localhost is its own container. For a MongoDB in another container, put both on one Docker network and use that container’s name; for one on this computer, use host.docker.internal (on Linux, start Mongo Manager with --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway; it reaches a MongoDB listening on the Docker gateway’s address, not one bound to 127.0.0.1 only). Started with --network host, localhost is this computer and works as typed.

encryption.enabledHint: Encrypted fields are decrypted for those who may see the data and encrypted when they write. Others see them as stored.

encryption.localKeyHint: Keep a copy somewhere safe: without it the data cannot be decrypted.

encryption.freshKeyBody: This is the new key. It is shown only now: copy or download it and keep it somewhere safe before you save.

encryption.teamLibrary: This server uses its own crypt_shared library (MM_CRYPT_SHARED_LIB_PATH).

encryption.mongocryptdHint: On this computer only. Empty: mongocryptd is started from the server’s PATH.
encryption.mapHint: Extended JSON keyed by database.collection. Empty: the server’s own collection options are used.
encryption.maskingNote: Someone who may not see personal data never gets decrypted values: they see the encrypted value as stored, and cannot write documents here.

reasons.kerberos_unavailable: Kerberos needs the optional kerberos package, which this server does not have (npm package only).
reasons.kerberos_team_disabled: Kerberos is turned off on this server: in team mode it would sign every user in as the server’s own account (MM_ALLOW_KERBEROS).
reasons.workload_identity_team_disabled: A workload identity is turned off on this server in team mode (MM_ALLOW_WORKLOAD_IDENTITY).
reasons.encryption_unavailable: Client-side encryption needs the optional mongodb-client-encryption package, which this server does not have (npm package only).
reasons.crypt_shared_path_team: In team mode only the server’s own crypt_shared library is used: leave the path empty.
reasons.crypt_shared_path_needed: Give the absolute path of the crypt_shared library, or use mongocryptd.
reasons.crypt_shared_path_invalid: The crypt_shared library must be the file mongo_crypt_v1 (.so, .dylib or .dll) on this computer, never on a network share.
reasons.mongocryptd_not_local: mongocryptd sees every query in the clear: it must run on this computer.
reasons.oidc_host_not_allowed: A host of this connection is not an allowed host for OIDC sign-in: add it to the allowed hosts if your sign-in may go there.
reasons.oidc_needs_tls: OIDC sends an access token to the server: turn TLS on (with certificate checks), or reach the server through an SSH tunnel.
reasons.oidc_token_resource_unconfirmed: Confirm the token resource: this server’s own cloud identity gets a token for it and sends it to the connection’s hosts.
reasons.oidc_workload_unconfirmed: Confirm the workload identity: this server’s own cloud identity signs in to the connection’s hosts.
reasons.encryption_masked_write: Personal data is hidden from you on this connection, so you cannot write documents where client-side encryption is used.
reasons.encryption_decrypt_only: This connection decrypts only: documents are not written through it.
reasons.encryption_not_set_up: Client-side encryption is not set up on this connection.
reasons.kms_provider_missing: The connection has no such key provider.
reasons.kms_host_not_allowed: This key management service is not one the connection may reach: use the provider’s own host, an endpoint of the connection’s settings, or ask an operator to list it (MM_KMS_ALLOWED_HOSTS).
reasons.encryption_keys_hidden: Personal data is hidden from you on this connection, so its encryption keys are not shown.
reasons.not_oidc: This connection does not sign in with OIDC.
reasons.oidc_workload: This connection signs in with a workload identity, not a person.
reasons.oidc_issuer: The identity provider’s settings are not valid.
reasons.oidc_issuer_unreachable: The identity provider could not be reached.
reasons.oidc_pkce: The identity provider does not offer PKCE with S256.
reasons.oidc_device_unsupported: The identity provider does not offer sign-in with a code.
reasons.oidc_no_idp: The MongoDB server named no identity provider: check the hosts, the allowed hosts and that the server signs in with OIDC.
reasons.oidc_busy: Too many sign-ins are waiting. Try again in a few minutes.
reasons.oidc_issuer_mismatch: The MongoDB server names another identity provider than the one this connection expects: nobody is sent there.
reasons.oidc_device_off: Sign-in with a code is turned off on this server (MM_OIDC_DEVICE_FLOW).
reasons.oidc_redirect_foreign: In team mode the identity provider sends people back to this server only: clear the connection’s redirect address.
reasons.oidc_per_person: Each person signs in to this connection with their own account, so the server cannot do this on its own.
reasons.oidc_token: The identity provider refused the sign-in.
reasons.oidc_sign_in: Sign in with your identity provider to use this connection.
reasons.encrypted_connection: The assistant does not write documents where client-side encryption is used.
reasons.oidc_level2: Each person signs in to this connection with their own account, so the server cannot do this on its own (level 2 is switched off again by the server). Use level 1 instead.

hints.monotonicHelp: A ranged field that grows with time (ObjectId, dates) sends every new document to one shard. Hash it, or put another field first.

verdictHelp.good: Many distinct values, evenly spread: chunks can be split and balanced well.

verdictHelp.poor: Few distinct values, or one value in many documents: chunks cannot be split well. Choose another key.
